services_enterprise_software_description: We design and build high-performance, scalable platforms for fintech and payments. Specializing in Event-Driven Architecture and DDD, we create backends that keep heavy transaction volumes consistent.
services_legacy_modernization_descriptio: We rescue businesses from technical debt. Our squads use AI-assisted analysis and refactoring to map outdated systems (Node.js, PHP, legacy monoliths) and migrate critical paths to modern standards.
services_cloud_devops_description: We cut cloud waste with FinOps, then run your platform as managed platform and SRE engineers. From cost visibility to automated CI/CD (Kubernetes/Helm), we keep infrastructure secure and efficient.
services_staff_augmentation_description: Scale your tech team without the risk. Vetted developers work as managed squads under senior architects, with SLAs and outcomes agreed up front. We don't just provide heads; we oversee quality and delivery.
services_staff_augmentation_proof_point: We operate today as a delivery partner to IT-services primes, staffing and delivering work for their enterprise end clients — the same offshore delivery model available to you, direct.
services_ai_engineering_description: We build LLM, RAG and agent features into production backends, not demos. Our senior engineers handle the hard parts (evaluation, retrieval quality, observability, guardrails and cost control).
services_security_compliance_description: We build compliance-ready engineering into how you ship. Our squads set up secure SDLC practices (threat modeling, dependency scanning, SBOMs), incident-reporting tooling and compliance-evidence automation.

privacy_meta_description: How Oni Web Officer collects, uses and protects personal data under GDPR, LGPD and US privacy law, including your rights and our contact details.
privacy_intro: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data Oni Web Officer collects when you visit this website, why, and the rights you have under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Brazil's Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD), and US state privacy laws.
privacy_controller_body: The data controller responsible for this website is Henrique Fleury Cardoso Consultoria em Tecnologia da Informação LTDA, trading as Oni Web Officer, CNPJ 35.625.710/0001-91, registered at R. Odilon Braga 423, Anchieta, Belo Horizonte – MG, Brazil.
privacy_gdpr_body: If you are located in the European Economic Area, we process personal data on the following legal bases under Article 6 of the GDPR: your consent, for analytics with PostHog and when you choose to send us your details (Article 6(1)(a)); our legitimate interest in operating, monitoring and securing this website, for error monitoring with Sentry, hosting with DigitalOcean and delivery and protection with Cloudflare (Article 6(1)(f)); and, where applicable, the steps necessary to enter into a contract with you (Article 6(1)(b)). You have the right to access, rectify, erase and restrict the processing of your personal data, the right to data portability, and the right to object to processing, including profiling. You may also lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority. Our service providers process data in the United States (Sentry, Cloudflare and DigitalOcean) and in the European Union (PostHog), as described under Service Providers. For transfers outside the EEA, we rely on the EU–US Data Privacy Framework where the provider is certified under it, and on the Standard Contractual Clauses in each provider's data processing agreement.
privacy_us_privacy_body: For visitors in the United States, we extend a baseline set of privacy rights modeled on state consumer privacy laws such as the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA/CPRA), regardless of which state you are in. This includes the right to know what personal data we hold about you, the right to request deletion of that data, the right to correct inaccurate data, and the right to non-discrimination for exercising these rights. We do not sell or share personal data for cross-context behavioral advertising.
privacy_lgpd_body: For visitors in Brazil, we process personal data under the legal bases set out in Article 7 of the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD, Law No. 13.709/2018): your consent, for analytics with PostHog (Article 7, I), and our legitimate interest in operating, monitoring and securing this website, for error monitoring with Sentry, hosting with DigitalOcean and delivery and protection with Cloudflare (Article 7, IX). Some of this data is transferred outside Brazil, to the United States and the European Union, as described under Service Providers; these international transfers rely on the safeguards allowed by Article 33 of the LGPD, namely the standard contractual clauses in each provider's data processing agreement. You have the right to confirm the existence of processing, access your data, correct incomplete or outdated data, request anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary data, request portability, and revoke your consent at any time. Our Encarregado (Data Protection Officer) can be reached at oniweb@oniweb.com.br.
privacy_cookies_body: This website uses two functional cookies that need no consent: lang, which remembers the language you pick (English, Portuguese or Swedish), and cookie_consent, which remembers whether you accepted or rejected optional cookies. Both last one year and have no tracking or advertising purpose. Only after you click "Accept all", PostHog sets two analytics cookies, ph_…_posthog and ph_…_posthog_cpm, which last one year, and keeps matching entries in your browser's local storage and session storage; they hold a random identifier that lets us count visits and understand how the site is used. If you click "Reject non-essential", nothing is sent to PostHog and it only keeps a small opt-out flag in local storage to remember your choice. Sentry stores nothing on your device. We do not use advertising cookies. To change your choice, clear the cookies and site data for oniweb.com.br in your browser settings, which brings the cookie banner back, or email us at henrique@oniweb.com.br. The email field on our homepage only opens your own email app with a message addressed to us; this website does not store what you type, and analytics never records it.
privacy_providers_body: We use four service providers to run this website, and they process data on our behalf. Sentry (United States) receives error reports and performance traces from the website and from our server, including the page URL, the referring page, browser and device details, language and time zone; it sets no cookies on your device, does not store your IP address, and keeps this data for 30 days. We rely on our legitimate interest in keeping the website working and secure. PostHog (data hosted in the European Union) receives page views and interactions such as clicks, together with the page URL, the referring page and browser and device details, only after you click "Accept all". PostHog uses your IP address to estimate your approximate location (country and city) and then discards it without storing it; it keeps analytics data for up to 7 years. We rely on your consent, which you can withdraw at any time (see Cookies We Use). Cloudflare (United States, operating a global network) sits in front of this website to deliver it quickly and protect it from attacks, and processes your IP address and request data on every visit. DigitalOcean (servers in the United States) hosts our server, which records your IP address and request details in its server logs. For Cloudflare and DigitalOcean, we rely on our legitimate interest in operating and securing the website.
cookie_banner_message: We use functional cookies to remember your language and this choice. If you accept, PostHog analytics cookies help us understand how the site is used; if you reject, nothing is sent to PostHog.
privacy_future_body: If we add features that process personal data in new ways, such as a contact or scheduling form, we will update this Privacy Policy before we introduce that new processing, and we will only use the data you submit for the purpose you submitted it for.
privacy_contact_body: To exercise any of the rights described above, or for any privacy question, contact us at henrique@oniweb.com.br. For LGPD-specific requests, you may also reach our Encarregado, Oni Web Officer, at oniweb@oniweb.com.br.
